params.prompt:
A commercial-quality modern pixel-art life simulation set in a fictional contemporary Korean city.

2.5D three-quarter top-down open-world perspective, believable architectural depth, layered foreground and background, strong sense of walkable space, crisp deliberate pixel edges, consistent pixel scale, dense environmental storytelling, subtle atmospheric lighting, grounded proportions.

The protagonist's world feels ordinary at first glance but contains understated black comedy about work, money, debt, education, consumption and modern city life.

Muted everyday colors with carefully controlled neon and warm practical lights. Rich detail without visual clutter. Human-scale streets, believable interiors, clear entrances, sidewalks and paths suitable for actual gameplay.

Not a voxel world. Not block-based. Not glossy mobile-game fantasy. Not photorealistic. Avoid readable AI-generated text. Leave signboards suitable for later Unity text overlays.

Modern dense pixel art with crisp deliberate clustered edges and grounded silhouettes; slate, navy and warm brown city surfaces, subdued dark-clothed residents, restrained amber practical lights and teal traffic accents. Ordinary Korean urban life with quiet irony about work and debt, warm sparse homes contrasting with active streets. Consistent elevated three-quarter top-down game perspective, no extreme isometric tilt, clear walkable lanes, readable entrances, layered foreground objects, consistent human scale, blank signboards and no logos.


Show ONLY ONE standalone convenience store INTERIOR, filling the WHOLE image. No city view, no exterior, no inset, no split panel. Orthographic elevated three-quarter top-down cutaway room. Dense snack aisles with clear passages, chilled drinks along rear wall, instant meals, cashier counter left, microwave eating area with two stools right. Cool fluorescent light. NO people, NO text or brands.
